summary: Join our Strategic Banking and State-Owned Financial Institutions Training Course to gain essential skills and knowledge for effective financial management.
lede: Banking strategy links an institution’s mandate, business model and risk appetite to clear priorities and measurable performance. The course is for executives, board members and strategy, risk or public-sector professionals who shape or implement plans for state-owned and policy-driven financial institutions. Participants learn to clarify mandates and governance, align portfolios and financial measures with purpose, and build risk-aware roadmaps for execution and stakeholder communication.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape or implement strategy in banking and state-owned financial institutions. It targets those who need to understand the intricacies of strategic banking and governance.
audience: Senior managers and executives in commercial
Board members and board secretaries of public
modules: Strategic Role of Banks and State-Owned Financial Institutions
Financial Performance and Value Creation in SOFIs
Digital Transformation and Innovation in Banking and SOFIs
Strategy for Development Impact and Public Policy Goals
Strategy Execution, Transformation, and Change Management
prerequisites: Participants should have a fundamental understanding of banking operations and be involved in strategic roles within their organizations.
